_comment: Project-scoped Claude Code settings. Environment variables for MCP servers live in .vscode/settings.json (claude-code.env) — see .vscode/settings.json.example. Users should not need to edit ~/.claude/settings.json for this project.

hooks.comment: Hook registration is done here if you want the orchestrator's automated KG/codegraph sync to fire on file edits. See .claude/hooks/ for the scripts. Install with: cp .claude/settings.json.with-hooks .claude/settings.json (or let install.py set this up for you).
